purpose: Public integrity attestation for the 92-asset standalone commercial portfolio and 95-project development register. It binds the published valuation register, methodology and verified public project-site directory without disclosing private source code, private evidence artifacts or security-sensitive implementation detail.

verification.browserIntegrity: The public renderer fetches the valuation register and methodology as raw text, recomputes SHA-256 in the browser and compares the result with this attestation.
verification.valuationReconciliation: The public renderer assembles the current asset register, applies published overrides, recalculates asset-level analytical economics and compares aggregate values with the published portfolio totals.
verification.publicSiteDirectory: The public project-site enhancer recomputes the SHA-256 digest of the site directory before presenting its integrity state.
verification.existenceBoundary: The timestamped public publication and matching digests demonstrate existence and integrity of the public commercial record as published. They do not independently prove authorship, legal title, patent priority, source-code identity, scientific validity, security assurance, certified valuation or commercial outcome.
verification.futureEconomicReferences: The public renderer verifies the SHA-256 digest of the 95-project milestone-conditioned economic-reference register. Numeric entries are maturity-only sensitivities, not forecasts or current values.
verification.sellerReadiness: The public renderer verifies the SHA-256 digests of the seller-readiness, ownership, supply-chain and audit-certificate records before presenting acquisition-readiness status.
verification.creatorProvenance: The public renderer verifies the development-provenance and trade-secret classification records. Historical multi-AI development provenance is owner-declared; current repository baselines remain independently auditable through repository evidence.

privacyBoundary: Public records expose seller-side status, owner-declared provenance, evidence metadata, hashes and transfer boundaries only. Deleted historical AI conversation chains are not retained. Surviving private know-how, credentials, customer data, sensitive implementation details and transaction-confidential material remain outside the public showroom.
